banner.subtitle: One click: discussions, emails, notes, tracking.

sections.title: Message Filter on Chatter for Odoo
sections.tagline: Stop scrolling through the whole chatter.
sections.subtitle: A Filter by: row of coloured badges above the messages: click one to see only discussions, emails, notes or tracking.

sections.flow_alt: Open a record, see the badges, click one, only those messages are shown
sections.html: A long-lived record has hundreds of messages: talks, emails, notes, changed fields and automatic notices, all mixed. The search box only finds words. Message Filter on Chatter shows one kind at a time, with the number of messages of each kind.

items.title: Seven badges
items.text: All, Discussions, Emails, Activities, Notes, Tracking and Other, each with its own colour.

items.title: A count on each
items.text: You see how many messages of each kind before you click.

items.title: One click
items.text: One kind at a time: the badge fills with its colour. Click All to come back.

items.title: Done by the server
items.text: Load more works on the filtered list, not only on what is loaded.

items.title: Every message once
items.text: Each message is in exactly one kind, so the counts add up.

items.title: Always All on open
items.text: The choice is not kept: nobody misses a message without knowing.

sections.title: The whole picture
sections.alt: A record with its chatter on the right: the Filter by label and the badges All, Discussions, Emails, Activities, Notes, Tracking and Other, under the planned activities and above the messages
sections.intro: On a wide screen the chatter sits beside the record. Filter by: comes under the planned activities and above the messages. Each badge has its own colour and its count.

sections.title: Discussions
sections.intro: Send message, whether it went to internal followers or to a customer linked to the record.

sections.title: Emails
sections.intro: Emails received and emails sent. The email sent from the Email Composer is here too.

sections.title: Activities
sections.intro: The message Odoo leaves when a planned activity is marked as done, with its feedback.

sections.title: Tracking

sections.title: Requirements & Installation
sections.intro: Needs only the standard mail module. No external library.
notes: For internal users. The choice of badge is not kept: the next time you open a record, all messages are shown.

blocks.html: 1. Copy the dwo_chatter_filter folder into an add-ons path of your Odoo server.
2. Restart Odoo, activate developer mode and click Update Apps List in the Apps menu.
3. Search for Message Filter on Chatter and click Install.
Reload your browser page after installing so the new assets are loaded.
Under Filter by:, click a badge to see that kind of message only. Click All to see everything again.
Discussions: Send message. Emails: emails received and sent. Activities: the message left by a done activity. Notes: Log note. Tracking: changed fields. Other: automatic messages and the rest.
A badge with no message is greyed out.
It works in the chatter of a record, not in Discuss or the inbox.
One kind at a time. While you search messages with the magnifier, the badges are hidden.

items.q: In which badge is an email sent from the Email Composer?
items.a: In Emails. It is an outgoing email, even though it has the subtype of a discussion.

items.q: Does the Activities badge filter the planned activities?
items.a: No. It shows the messages left when an activity is marked as done. The planned activities stay in their own list above the badges.

items.q: Where are the changes of a field?

items.a: No. Open the record again and all the messages are shown, so nobody misses a message without knowing.

items.q: Does Load more work when a badge is chosen?
items.a: Yes. The server returns only that kind, so Load more goes on in the filtered list.

items.q: Does it work with other modules that change the chatter?
items.a: It adds one row above the messages and does not touch the messages themselves. It runs together with the Email Composer.

sections.headline: Find the message you need in one click.
sections.text: Install it and open the chatter of any record.
